audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Gnar / Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Gnar / Skill / Gnar, giving Gnar five stages. The packet says Gnar / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Skill, and the packet matches the page's own whys at all seven rows: whys[1] 'genuinely even', whys[2] 'she owns this stretch', whys[3] 'she punishes it hard', whys[4] 'it's a coinflip on your form, so it's even', whys[5] 'out-trade your first-item spike', whys[6] 'settles into a teamfight skill matchup'. Separately, diff reads HARD while diffRating is 4/10, the tone is the green favoured colour and report[14] says 'Favoured matchup' — the page disagrees with itself about who is ahead.
audit.why: A 50.97% win rate does not support a chart with five Gnar stages, and it does not support difficulty 4/10 either.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers to the packet, ratings moved to match, diff set to EVEN with diffRating 6/10 and the tone, difficulty line, rating line and chart blurb brought into agreement.
sources: currentText diff HARD vs diffRating 4/10 vs report[14].t

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 1 ranged window, Lvl 2-3 Test of Spirit, Lvl 6 Leap of Faith field, first-item field fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson is never mentioned anywhere on the page, and Test of Spirit is described only as having a 'long cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 4s leap onto the target that resets her attack and makes every nearby tentacle swing at you — it is how she closes on a kiting Gnar, and its wind-up is the burst tell. Calling it a long cooldown is misleading for Test of Spirit too: it is 16/15/14/13/12, so 14s at rank 3 is the real window.
audit.corrected: Harsh Lesson named with its 4s cooldown and reset in the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions; Test of Spirit's 14s written into the do's, Key Ability Interactions and wants.you[1].
sources: enemyKit Illaoi W cd 4, dash and autoReset flags, text

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Land Test of Spirit' in wants.foe[0] — that is the correct ability name, a false positive, left alone. The kit file flags Leap of Faith with 'untargetable' and 'grounding', and _missing raises an untargetable-dodges-burst item from it, but Riot's R description says only that she smashes her idol, damages nearby enemies and spawns a tentacle per champion hit — no untargetability and no grounding. Per the rule to trust the description over a derived flag, I wrote nothing about waiting out an untargetable window or about dashes being shut off. No mirror audit exists for illaoi__gnar; these findings should be restated inverted when it is written.
